evals.prompt: Audit a plan that has stakeholder detail and architecture notes but does not prove root cause, owner boundary, correct seam, SRP/cohesion, or recurrence guard.
evals.expected_output: plan-360-audit must FAIL until the plan proves root cause, ownership, domain boundary, correct seam, required fix-now refactors, and recurrence guard. The report may list blocking conditions, but it must not return PASS or CONDITIONAL PASS.
assertions: Checks Root-Cause Structural Gate as a required gate.
Does not allow implementation when root cause, ownership, correct seam, SRP/cohesion, domain boundary, standard work, or recurrence guard is FAIL or UNPROVEN.
Requires exact tasks, files or symbols, owner boundary, acceptance criteria, and verification for any FIX-NOW refactor before implementation.

evals.prompt: Audit a plan whose Evidence Ledger marks DB schema and runtime route behavior as UNPROVEN, then says build will confirm during implementation.
evals.expected_output: plan-360-audit must fail because load-bearing UNPROVEN or CONTRADICTED evidence cannot support PASS or CONDITIONAL PASS.
assertions: Rejects load-bearing unproven assumptions that build would need to prove later.
Treats migration-only, diff-only, mock-only, or stale-memory proof as insufficient for runtime/schema claims when stronger evidence is available.
Requires planning, discovery, or source/runtime proof to resolve blockers before implementation.
